verdict.rationale: Snowflake's own Time Travel feature keeps changed or deleted data for a "defined period", during which it can be queried and restored. Deletes are a documented DML operation, as stream tracking shows. However, the evidence never says users can configure that retention window, permanently purge data, or set retention policies. missing for 10: documented user-configurable retention periods (e.g., per-object retention settings), explicit permanent deletion/purge controls beyond Time Travel and Fail-safe, retention policies for AI/Cortex data, independent corroboration.
